name: Close-Grip Bench Press
summary: A bench press with a narrower grip that shifts more of the load to the triceps while still working the chest.
setup: Lie on a flat bench with eyes under the bar and feet planted.
Grip the bar about shoulder width; not so narrow that the wrists bend.
Pull shoulder blades back and down.
Unrack with straight arms; set safety arms or use a spotter.
execution: Lower the bar under control to the lower chest, elbows close to the body.
Press the bar up until the arms are straight.
Keep wrists straight over forearms throughout.
cues: Press the bar up and slightly back
mistakes: Grip too narrow causing wrist pain: use about shoulder width.
Elbows flaring: keep them close to the ribs.
Bouncing the bar: pause and control it.
Hips rising: keep the glutes on the bench.

references.title: How To Do A Close Grip Barbell Bench Press
